source: Three of 40 seeds drawn 2026-11-04/05 (os.urandom, 64-bit; none a practice seed). The privileged reference (solution/privileged/oracle.py at its sha256 7a5c88e8) ran the candidates in drawn order, each in a simulator process of its own over the full 20000 steps (as verify runs an episode); a candidate was kept if it scored at least 0.90 (the maximum is 1.0) and stopped as soon as it no longer could (a request closed at 0 points caps S at 0.875). 14 ran, 3 kept: draws 3, 10 and 14, S = 0.9098, 0.9487 and 1.0000 (O 0.945 / 0.897 / 1.000, R 0.875 / 1.000 / 1.000). 11 dropped, each at a request that closed at 0 points. In 9 the named object lay in a container against a wall or in a corner, where no pinch fits: draws 1 and 4 (the foam brick and the cracker box of gray's initial pile), 11, 12 and 13 (the mustard bottle, the master chef can and again the mustard bottle in lightblue), 5 (a pudding box the world had misplaced into lightblue), 6 (a tuna can in a corner of lightblue), 9 (the pitcher base in a corner of blue) and 2 (a marker under five objects in blue, 1.9 cm from its wall once they were off). In 2 the grasps kept failing: draw 7 (the master chef can against lightblue's wall: leaning grasps) and 8 (the pitcher base). Draws 15-40 were not run. probe_key keys each episode's probe stream (with its seed).
